dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitting a falcate profile on the trailing edge, with curvature increasing from the mid-point to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with an obtuse pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Constant positive slope transitioning from the dorsal ridge at approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Cluster of small, circular white depigmented focal marks on the anterior-dorsal flank; irregular light-gray mottled patches on the mid-to-posterior surface of the dorsal fin.
